Subject: QBR Sprintboard — forecast stitch & account-level asks

Team,

As we lock the QBR deck next week I want a single sprintboard we can point to that captures: per-account committed forecast for Q2, current confidence, top three risks/asks, and owner-assigned actions. Purpose: the execs want one slide per named account that includes a 1-2 line health summary.

Ask: please fill the attached sprintboard with your accounts (rows) by 5pm PT tomorrow (Mon, 4 May). Fields: ARR (Q2 committed), forecast range (best/worst), confidence (H/M/L), top 3 risks, immediate action(s) & owner, and any gating procurement/legal items.

I'm attaching a starter grid (qbr_sprintboard_grid.xlsx) and a template for the one-pagers. If you want, paste the per-account 1-2 line summary in a reply to this thread and I'll copy into the slide notes.

Priority accounts for this sprint: Nimbus Analytics (renewal + upsell), Acme Mobility (pilot -> enterprise), and two mid-market plays (listed in the grid).

If there's any blocker to meeting the deadline (e.g., waiting on legal redlines from a customer), call it out in-reply and tag the owner. I'll consolidate and push to design on Tue AM.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Quick summaries (copyable for slide notes):
- Nimbus Analytics — Forecast: $1.1M Q2 committed (renewal + 20% uplift). Confidence: Medium. Top risks: procurement delay (legal redline outstanding), and model validation timing. Ask: Legal to review SOW amendment by 5/7. Owner: Marissa. HubSpot: 7421.
- Acme Mobility — Forecast: $420k pilot -> expected $1.2M ARR on convert. Confidence: Low->Medium (pilot in progress). Top risks: integration latency on their edge devices; require 2-week benchmark. Ask: Engineering to own bench test; schedule Novacall. Owner: Tessa.
- Greencore Retail — Forecast: $210k (expansion). Confidence: High. Renewal window closed. No legal blockers.

All — consolidated the inputs and attached the combined forecast CSV (consolidated_forecast_2026Q2.csv). Notes from consolidation:
- Nimbus Analytics: left at $1.1M committed, but downgraded to Medium confidence until legal clears the SOW (target 5/07).
- Acme Mobility: kept expected convert in a separate column ("upside"), moved the conservative committed to $420k. Marked as Low confidence until bench results are in.
- Overall Q2 committed (sum of conservative columns) now reads $4.53M — includes current pipelines we expect to close. Upside line shows an additional $1.2M if pilots convert.

Design: please pull the conservative committed column for the main slide; include a callout for "upside / contingent" with the bench/legal gating bullets.

Next steps: Jonas will approve the sprintboard; I'll hand the CSV and slide notes to design by EOD Tue. If anyone has an urgent correction, reply-all with a one-line correction and I'll update the master.
